card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle or end of rare proper names, mostly surnames and place names such as Zubov, Kreuzberg, Würzburg and Fairbank. Also fires on a piece inside a long drug name.

modes.description: A later piece of a rare surname or German or Russian place name split into several parts.
